caveats: ⚑ EXP CADENCE MERGE: the kit runs TWO independent EXP counters (6 non-core landed normals; 3 core hits). The engine's hitCount trigger cannot distinguish core from non-core per hit, and authoring both blocks would let every hit feed BOTH counters (0.5 EXP/hit vs a true (1+coreRate)/6). Merged into ONE hitCount:5 block whose effective rate assumes coreRate≈0.30 → (1+0.30)/6 = 0.217 EXP/hit ≈ 1 per 4.6 hits. count is UNMEASURED.

⚑ heroLevel is modeled as a resource pool (initial 1, max 11) incremented every 50 landed hits = 10× the EXP cadence, matching the kit's 10-EXP-per-level rule. Internally consistent with the 100-stack EXP cap (100 EXP = 10 level-ups = Level 11), but the 50 inherits the ⚑ on the EXP cadence.

⚑ The level-up REWARD riders (10.26% reload, 2.44% Max-HP recovery) are bounded by resourceGate {heroLevel max 10} so exactly 10 level-ups fire; without that gate the hitCount trigger would keep paying rewards forever past Level 11.

⚑ perResource on ALLY-targeted buffs: the schema documents perResource as re-reading caster.resources each frame and recommends applying it as a passive SELF buff. Here it is applied to alliesOfElement Water (which includes the Water caster). If the engine only resolves perResource for self-targets, the ally half of the Level aura goes inert — verify with a buffApply probe on a second Water ally.

⚑ 'Hero Level 2 or above' elemental-advantage buff is keyed to hitCount:50 + resourceGate min 2 rather than a passive, because a passive trigger fires once at setup when heroLevel is still 1. It therefore lands on the same hit as the first level-up only if skill1 blocks dispatch before skill2 in-frame; worst case it lands one level-up late (~50 extra hits, ≈5 s).
The burst DoT is left crit-OFF (global DOT_CRIT default) and FB-eligible by timing (no noFb) per the rider prior — both are measurement-gated, not asserted.
The 2.44% Max-HP recovery is modeled as a heal EVENT only (no HP pool in v1); its value drives teammates' on-recovery triggers, not any HP number.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Model: EXP is a self ATK stack (1.81%/stack, cap 100) fed by a MERGED hit counter standing in for the kit's two branches (6 non-core landed normals / 3 core hits) — merged because the engine cannot route a single hit to exactly one of two hitCount blocks, and authoring both would roughly double the true EXP rate. Hero Level is a declared resource pool (initial 1, cap 11) bumped once per 10 EXP (every 50 hits), gated to exactly 10 level-ups; the level-up rewards (partial reload — a shots-fired/weapon-state effect, therefore damage-relevant, not skippable — and the self heal, kept for tandem on-recovery consumers) ride that block. The two 'continuously * Hero Level' Water-ally auras and the burst DoT are perResource-scaled off that same pool so they track the live level instead of being frozen at a guessed average. Burst team buffs use burstCast (this unit's own burst block) so they only fire on rotations she actually casts; the 10 s DoT keeps default FB-by-timing. Nothing in this file is calibrated to any board or probe total.

flags.estimate: 5 landed hits per EXP stack (assumes AR core rate ≈ 0.30)
flags.reasoning: The kit's two EXP branches are mutually exclusive per hit: rate = coreRate/3 + (1−coreRate)/6 = (1+coreRate)/6 stacks per landed hit. The engine's hitCount cannot partition hits by core, so both branches are merged into one counter. coreRate for an AR at scope-lock range is not in the kit text and is itself a ⚑ (Hit-Rate→core is measured-only), so count is an estimate, not a datum. At coreRate 0 → count 6; at 1/3 → 4.5; at 1.0 → 3.
flags.recipe: From a recorded fight, count the unit's landed normal hits and the CORE-tagged (red 'CORE HIT') subset over a fixed window → coreRate. Then count = round(6/(1+coreRate)). Cross-check independently by timing the first ATK-buff buffApply stacks: stacks(t) should be hits(t)/count until the 100 cap.

flags.estimate: 50 landed hits per Hero Level (10 × the EXP cadence)
flags.reasoning: The kit fixes the RATIO (10 EXP per level) but not the hit count; 50 is 10× the ⚑ EXP cadence and inherits its uncertainty. It is corroborated internally: the 100-stack EXP cap × 1 level/10 EXP = 10 level-ups = the stated max Level 11 from a Level-1 start, so initial=1 / max=11 is kit-derived, not guessed.
flags.recipe: Re-derive as 10 × the measured EXP cadence above. Verify directly by watching the level-up reward: a partial reload every level-up is visible as an ammo-counter jump in footage — time the first 2-3 jumps and confirm the interval equals 10 EXP stacks' worth of hits.

flags.estimate: perResource resolves against the CASTER's pool for ally targets (assumed)
flags.reasoning: The schema's perResource note describes the self-buff application pattern ('apply as a passive self-buff so it is always present and re-reads the live pool'). This kit's level aura is explicitly team-scoped to Water allies, so ally-target resolution is load-bearing here. If unsupported, the aura silently pays only the caster and every other Water ally gets nothing.
flags.recipe: Run a comp with a second Water ally, capture buffApply events filtered by stat casterAtkPct / elemAdvantageDamagePct with targetSlug ≠ guillotine-winter-slayer, and assert the emitted value climbs with heroLevel (casterAtkPct emits FLAT ATK = 0.91×level/100 × caster.staticAtk). If no ally event appears, split the aura into a self perResource block + an ally block using a stepped stack model.

flags.estimate: lands at the first level-up (~50 hits, ≈5 s); worst case one level-up late
flags.reasoning: resourceGate is evaluated at trigger time, so it needs a RE-FIRING trigger; a passive would be evaluated once at setup with heroLevel=1 and be dead for the whole fight. Keying it to the same hitCount:50 cadence makes it exact only if skill1's level-up block dispatches before skill2's in the same frame.
flags.recipe: Assert the buffApply frame for stat elemAdvantageDamagePct value 7.46 against the frame of the first heroLevel increment. If it lags a full cycle, halve the gate cadence (hitCount:25, gate min:2) — the gate, not the cadence, controls correctness.

flags.estimate: noFb OFF (FB-eligible by tick timing), crit OFF
flags.reasoning: Per the rider prior, function damage takes Full Burst by TIMING and per-kit noFb is measured-only; the DoT ticks for 10 s across the FB window, so ticks inside it should take the +50%. DoT crit is validated-off for most carriers and the global gate is default-OFF; the kit gives no crit language.
flags.recipe: Read the boss popup stream during a burst: DoT ticks inside FB should be ~1.5× the out-of-FB ticks (isolate by casting the burst so ticks straddle the FB edge). Colour-check the same ticks for orange/crit icons before ever setting crit:true.

flags.reasoning: Kit-derived rather than guessed — 100 EXP cap ÷ 10 EXP/level = 10 level-ups, and the stated maximum is Level 11, which only closes if the fight starts at Level 1. Consequence: the Level-aura pays 1×(1.16/0.91) from t=0, before any level-up has occurred, which the literal 'Activates when Hero levels up' clause arguably withholds until Level 2.
flags.recipe: If a t=0 aura is disproven (no buffApply before the first level-up in footage/event log), set initial to 1 but move the aura onto the level-up block with a resourceGate min:2, or set initial 0 and shift every level-scaled coefficient by one step.
